name: stage138-vless-vmess-utls-reality-vision-blocker-gate
gate_decision: stage138 is a hard blocker gate: VLESS/VMess shared transport lifecycle rows through xHTTP H3 are complete, but protocol-wide admission remains blocked until real uTLS wire parity, VLESS REALITY full handshake, and VLESS Vision intrinsic conn hooks exist; rustls evidence and REALITY session-id AEAD mutation are not enough

rows.evidence: Stage134-137 carry gRPC HTTP/2, WSS TLS, HTTPS HTTPUpgrade TLS, xHTTP HTTP/2, xHTTP H3 TLS, and H2+H3 aggregate evidence
rows.boundary: completed lifecycle rows do not prove uTLS, REALITY, Vision, or protocol-wide admission
rows.next_action: keep these as prerequisites while implementing the residual hard rows

rows.evidence: Stage101 mirrors Go uTLS selection names, but current Rust path has no uTLS-compatible ClientHello wire stack and rustls is explicitly not uTLS
rows.boundary: name selection and rustls TLS handshakes cannot be used as uTLS fingerprint parity
rows.next_action: choose or implement a Rust uTLS-compatible wire stack, then compare deterministic ClientHello fixtures against Go uTLS

rows.evidence: Stage102 covers session-id AEAD mutation only; full uTLS handshake state, VerifyPeerCertificate, and spider fallback are not connected
rows.boundary: session-id crypto helper is not a full REALITY transport
rows.next_action: wire mutation into actual ClientHello Raw bytes and verify REALITY certificate/signature behavior

rows.evidence: Vision parser/export contract exists, but Vision requires intrinsic TLS/REALITY conn access
rows.boundary: ordinary stream wrapping and rustls outer TLS evidence do not satisfy Vision
rows.next_action: provide an intrinsic TLS/REALITY conn hook before adding Vision TCP/UDP dataplane smoke
